settings.title: Settings
settings.tray_desc: Closing the window keeps the music playing
settings.notifications_desc: A system notification when the track changes
settings.audio_devices_desc: Detected capabilities of each DAC (sample rates, formats, channels).
settings.audio_devices_buffer_hint: Range allowed by the driver. Smaller buffers reduce latency but raise the risk of dropouts.
settings.audio_devices_probed_hint: Obtained by direct WASAPI probing — bit-perfect in exclusive mode.
settings.audio_devices_windows_mix_hint: What Windows sends to the DAC in shared mode (mixer active).
settings.audio_devices_no_exclusive_title: Exclusive mode refused by this device
settings.audio_devices_no_exclusive_hint: The driver rejected every probed combination. Showing declared capabilities.
settings.audio_quality_desc: Quality vs. CPU cost trade-off. Auto picks based on your machine.
settings.audio_quality_high_desc: Maximum quality — 2048-tap DSD filter, high-precision resampler.
settings.audio_quality_medium_desc: Balanced — 1024-tap DSD filter, audibly identical for most listeners.
settings.audio_quality_low_desc: Compatibility — 512-tap DSD filter, DSD output at 44.1 kHz. For VMs / older PCs.
settings.audio_quality_minimal_desc: Degraded mode — 256-tap DSD filter, 5s buffer, 44.1 kHz output. Use this only if playback stutters in Compatibility mode (noticeable audio quality reduction).
settings.render_mode_desc: GPU acceleration or software rendering. Auto picks for your machine; applied at next launch.
settings.render_mode_vm_detected: Virtual machine detected ({kind}) — Automatic forces software rendering for stability.
settings.render_mode_restart_required: Restart RustMusic to apply this change.
settings.hardware_desc: Use GPU for audio decoding if available
settings.dlna_enabled_desc: Makes your libraries visible to amps, AVRs and speakers (Sonos…) on the local network.
settings.dlna_friendly_name_desc: Name shown in the DLNA server list on devices
settings.rescan_library_desc: Re-scan all folders and import new files
settings.open_data_folder_desc: The database and cover art, on this drive.
settings.reset_desc: Delete all data and return to initial state
settings.appearance_desc: Theme, sidebar, lists shown and window.
settings.audio_desc: Output, bit-perfect mode, decoding quality and volume.
settings.network_desc: Local network sharing and online services.
settings.gapless_desc: Plays an album's tracks back to back, without silence
settings.gapless_note: The next track is decoded ahead while you listen. Chaining only happens between tracks sharing the same sample rate and channel count; otherwise playback resumes normally.
settings.replay_gain_desc: Evens out volume across tracks and albums, based on the file tags.
settings.replay_gain_mode_off_desc: No correction: every file plays at the level it was mastered at.
settings.replay_gain_mode_track_desc: Every track is brought to the same perceived level. Best for playlists mixing different sources.
settings.replay_gain_mode_album_desc: All tracks on an album get the same correction, preserving the dynamics the artist intended. Recommended for album listening.
settings.replay_gain_note: Files without Replay Gain tags play unchanged. Native DSD (DoP) output is never affected.
settings.replay_gain_preamp_desc: Applied on top of the tag gain. Clipping protection stays active.
settings.exclusive_output_desc_linux: Opens the card directly through ALSA hw:, bypassing PipeWire/PulseAudio.
settings.exclusive_output_desc_macos: Takes exclusive control of the DAC (hog mode) and forces its native rate.
settings.exclusive_output_on_hint: Active — the stream leaves at the file’s native format
settings.exclusive_output_warning: RustMusic takes over the device: no other application can play sound while a track is playing. If the DAC refuses the format, playback falls back to shared output automatically.
settings.scan_on_startup_desc: Looks for new files in your libraries
settings.single_click_play_desc: Otherwise, a single click selects the track
settings.builtin_playlists_desc: Where these two built-in lists appear
settings.builtin_playlists_hidden_note: Hidden everywhere: only this setting brings it back. Its tracks stay intact.
settings.open_buttons_desc: Play a file or folder outside a library. Also offered on the home page.
settings.favorites_desc: On tracks, in the player and in the right-click menu. When off, “Liked tracks” disappears too.
settings.library_tabs_desc: Where to offer Tracks, Albums, Artists, Genres and Folders
settings.library_tabs_note: Hiding a section makes nothing unreachable: albums, artists and genres can still be opened from the tracks.
settings.system_media_controls_desc: Now playing in {os}, lock screen, media keys
settings.contrast_desc: “High” strengthens secondary text and separators, turns off background blur and makes keyboard focus clearly visible.
settings.contrast_high_note: Secondary text is darkened or lightened depending on the theme, background blurs are disabled, and keyboard focus becomes clearly visible.
settings.window_controls_style_desc: Auto follows the system: macOS lights, Windows or GNOME buttons
settings.window_controls_position_desc: Which side of the title bar they sit on
settings.repair_links_desc: Rebuilds the links to guest artists from “X;Y” and “X Feat. Y” tags
settings.repair_links_done: {links} link(s) across {multi} multi-artist track(s), {artists} entr(ies) added, {fixed} artist(s) corrected
settings.repair_links_none: Everything was already in place, nothing to rebuild
settings.wasapi_exclusive_on_hint: Active — WASAPI exclusive bypasses the Windows mixer
settings.wasapi_exclusive_off_hint: Inactive — audio via the Windows shared mixer
settings.wasapi_exclusive_desc: Bypass the Windows mixer to send audio directly to your DAC with no resampling and no system effects. Bit-perfect output in the file native format.
settings.wasapi_exclusive_warning: In exclusive mode, RustMusic takes full ownership of the audio device: no other application (browser, game, system notifications) will be able to play sound while a track is playing.
settings.dsd_dop_desc: Sends DSD files to the DAC without PCM conversion. Software volume is off: set it on the amp or DAC. If the DAC refuses, it falls back to PCM.
settings.dsd_dop_warning: DSD is sent as-is to the DAC (DoP), which decodes it natively. Software volume is disabled (bit-perfect): set the volume on your amp/DAC. If the DAC rejects the format, it automatically falls back to PCM conversion.
settings.auto_download_artist_images_desc: Query Deezer when opening an artist page that has no portrait. Bulk retrieval stays available on demand.
settings.search_empty_hint: Try another word, or another section.
settings.shortcuts_desc: The keys that drive RustMusic without a mouse.
settings.group_startup_hint: What happens when opening and closing
settings.group_playback_hint: How tracks and the queue behave
settings.resume_playback_desc: The last track picks up at the second you left it
settings.shortcuts_playback_hint: When no text field has focus
settings.shortcut_range_desc: In selection mode, from the last checked track
settings.shortcuts_media_off_desc: Media keys only control RustMusic when they're on.
settings.liked_needs_favorites: Hidden while the favorite button is off
settings.library_nav_hint: Where to put Tracks, Albums, Artists, Genres, Folders
settings.output_shared_desc_windows: Goes through the Windows mixer. Other apps stay audible.
settings.output_shared_desc_linux: Goes through PipeWire or PulseAudio. Other apps stay audible.
settings.output_shared_desc_macos: Goes through the macOS mixer. Other apps stay audible.
settings.output_exclusive_desc_windows: WASAPI exclusive: the file reaches the DAC untouched, without resampling.
settings.output_exclusive_desc_linux: Direct ALSA hw: the file reaches the DAC untouched, bypassing PipeWire and PulseAudio.
settings.output_exclusive_desc_macos: Exclusive (hog) mode: the DAC follows the file's sample rate, without resampling.
settings.output_exclusive_warning: During playback, RustMusic takes over the device: browser, games and notifications will have no sound. If the DAC refuses a format, it falls back to shared mode.
settings.dac_test_desc: Checks which sample rates {device} accepts in exclusive mode.
settings.audio_quality_auto_reason: Picked for your machine: {n} logical cores, {host}.
settings.audio_quality_high_summary: Resampling and DSD decoding at the highest level.
settings.audio_quality_high_advice: Recommended on a recent desktop PC.
settings.audio_quality_medium_summary: Nearly identical quality, lower CPU load.
settings.audio_quality_medium_advice: A good choice on a laptop.
settings.audio_quality_low_summary: Careful settings for modest machines; DSD comes out at 44.1 kHz.
settings.audio_quality_minimal_advice: Troubleshooting only, if Compatibility still stutters.
settings.replay_gain_hint: Evens out volume from the files' tags
settings.replay_gain_off_summary: No correction: each file plays at its mastering level.
settings.replay_gain_track_summary: Every track is brought to the same volume.
settings.replay_gain_album_summary: The whole album is corrected as one block: intended level differences between tracks are kept.
settings.replay_gain_album_advice: Ideal for listening to an album start to finish.
settings.dlna_group_hint: Play your libraries from an amp, AVR or speaker
settings.online_group_hint: What RustMusic fetches on its own
settings.storage_artist_images_desc: Fetches every artist's portrait from Deezer.
settings.backup_group_hint: Settings, profiles, playlists and liked tracks
settings.export_desc: A JSON file with settings, profiles, playlists and liked tracks. The library isn't included: a scan rebuilds it.
settings.import_desc: Replays an export file. Tracks are matched by path, or by tags if paths changed. Nothing is written before you confirm.
settings.import_preview_by_tags: By tags — the path had changed
settings.import_preview_missing_hint: If every path points to a missing folder, scan the library and try again.
settings.import_preview_missing_n: {n} tracks not found in this library. Playlists will be created without them.
settings.import_preview_missing_one: {n} track not found in this library. Playlists will be created without it.
settings.import_preview_playlists_skipped: Skipped — a playlist already has this name
settings.import_preview_replace: Replace playlists that already have this name.
settings.import_preview_replace_hint: Their current content will be lost. Unchecked, they are left untouched.
settings.reset_admin_kept: Only the default administrator profile will be kept.

pipeline.bit_perfect_desc: The file reaches the DAC untouched, with no resampling or system mixer.
pipeline.resampled_desc: The sample rate is converted for the output: the signal is recalculated.

pipeline.shared_desc: Sound goes through the system mixer, which may alter it.
pipeline.dop_desc: The DSD stream is sent as-is to the DAC (DoP), which decodes it natively — no PCM conversion.
pipeline.dop_transport_hint: DoP encapsulation: the DAC shows "DSD" and decodes the original 1-bit stream.
